title: 把 vs 被 Step 4 · Where 没 Goes, and When 把 Can't Be Used
description: 没, 不, 想 and 要 go before 把 / 被. And some sentences refuse 把 altogether: 知道, 喜欢, 有, unspecific things, and 看得懂-type verbs.

points.title: 没 / 不 / 想 / 要 come first
points.summary: Negation and wishes go **before** 把 or 被, never after.
points.body:
- 我**没**把作业做完。 ✔ ~~我把作业没做完~~ ✘
- 他**没**被抓住。 ✔
- 我**想**把房间打扫干净。 ✔

| | pattern | the subject … | feeling |
|---|---|---|---|
| **把** | doer + 把 + thing + verb + result | **does** something to the thing | what you did to it |
| **被** | thing + 被 + (doer) + verb + result | **receives** the action | often bad luck: got …ed |

**Both** need something after the verb: ~~我把饭吃~~ → 我把饭吃**完了** · ~~杯子被打~~ → 杯子被打**破了**.
**没 / 不 / 想 / 要** go **before** 把 / 被: 我**没**把作业做完 · 他**没**被抓住.

points.title: Sentences 把 refuses
points.summary: No 把 with feelings/knowing (知道, 喜欢, 认识), 是 / 有, a non-specific thing (一个苹果), or 'can / can't' verbs (看得懂, 吃不完).
points.body:
- ~~我把他知道~~ → 我知道他
- ~~我把一个苹果吃了~~ → 我把**那个**苹果吃了
- ~~我把这本书看得懂~~ → 这本书我看得懂

| | pattern | the subject … | feeling |
|---|---|---|---|
| **把** | doer + 把 + thing + verb + result | **does** something to the thing | what you did to it |
| **被** | thing + 被 + (doer) + verb + result | **receives** the action | often bad luck: got …ed |

**Both** need something after the verb: ~~我把饭吃~~ → 我把饭吃**完了** · ~~杯子被打~~ → 杯子被打**破了**.
**没 / 不 / 想 / 要** go **before** 把 / 被: 我**没**把作业做完 · 他**没**被抓住.

questions.explanation: 没 / 不 / 想 / 要 / 别 → **before** 把 / 被.
notes: 没 must come before 被.
想 before 把. ✔
没 before 把. ✔
想 must come before 把.
没 before 被. ✔
没 must come before 把.

questions.prompt: Build it: 'I didn't bring my passport.'
Which verbs can **not** be used in a 把 sentence? Select all.
questions.explanation: 把 needs a verb that **does something to** the thing.
notes: A feeling, not a handling.
把饭吃完了 ✔
是 links, it doesn't act.
Knowing isn't done **to** something.
把书放在桌子上 ✔
Having isn't an action on the thing.

questions.prompt: Why is 「{我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{那|nà}{本|běn}{书|shū}{看|kàn}{得|de}{懂|dǒng}。」 wrong?
options: It needs 了 at the end.
'Can / can't' verbs (看得懂, 看不懂) don't go with 把.
questions.explanation: No 把 with **得/不 + result** verbs: say 那本书我看得懂.
notes: 了 won't fix it.
被 doesn't fit — 'I' am the reader.
把 needs a **specific** thing — 那本书 is right.

questions.explanation: 把 = handling a **specific** thing with an action + result.
notes: ✔ specific.
Feelings can't take 把 → 我喜欢中文.
知道 can't take 把 → 我知道他.
'An apple' isn't specific → 那个苹果.

questions.prompt: 'If you don't explain it clearly, I won't help you.' Which sentence says so?
options: {你|nǐ}{把|bǎ}{话|huà}{说|shuō}{不|bu}{清楚|qīngchu}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{不|bù}{帮|bāng}{你|nǐ}。
{你|nǐ}{把|bǎ}{话|huà}{不|bù}{说|shuō}{清楚|qīngchu}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{不|bù}{帮|bāng}{你|nǐ}。
{你|nǐ}{不|bù}{把|bǎ}{话|huà}{说|shuō}{清楚|qīngchu}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{不|bù}{帮|bāng}{你|nǐ}。
{你|nǐ}{把|bǎ}{不|bù}{话|huà}{说|shuō}{清楚|qīngchu}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{不|bù}{帮|bāng}{你|nǐ}。
notes: 说不清楚 = 'unable to' — and that can't go with 把 anyway.
不 must come before 把.
不 can't split 把 from its object.
questions.translation: If you don't explain it clearly, I won't help you.

questions.prompt: Build it: 'He wasn't caught by the police.'
questions.translation: He wasn't caught by the police.
